name: Snd_PlayGameSound
notes: Id dispatch: nibble 0 SE table 0x005845F8, 1 BGM 0x00580354/0x005803F8 (ch 15), 2 voice 0x00580448 (ch 16), 8 stop; loop list 0x005887FC / _OFF list 0x005888B0; sets current BGM 0x009C8FB8. Port: game::ResolveSound + SoundDriver::PlayGameSound

name: Snd_PlayFile
signature: int __cdecl (const char* path, int loop, int channel, uint32_t id)
notes: Frees idle uncached SE channels, picks channel 0..14 (or explicit <21), reuses cached buffer of same id from ring 0x008101C8 via DuplicateSoundBuffer, opens (ch 15 streamed 3000 ms), plays. Port: SoundDriver::PlayFile

name: Snd_StopLoopedSe
notes: Snd_StopChannel on every remembered looped SE channel (0x00810150, count 0x008101F8), count = 0

name: Snd_Command
notes: 0x2A0 pause BGM, 0x3A0 resume BGM (looped), 0x300A0/0x1100A0 stop+release SE 0..14 (stop test inverted); 0x100A0/0x800A0/0x900A0 no-op

name: Snd_Init
notes: Snd_CreateDirectSound(hwnd 0x007DE62C, 21 channels, 44100, 2, 2) + Snd_InitFileSlots

name: Snd_CreateDirectSound
signature: int __cdecl (HWND, int channels, int rate, int nch, int bytesPerSample)
notes: DirectSoundCreate, DSSCL_PRIORITY, primary buffer PRIMARYBUFFER|CTRL3D, QI IDirectSound3DListener (0x00570FA0), SetFormat, Compact; channel array malloc(n*0x44) -> 0x007DE5A8

name: Snd_Shutdown
notes: Stops primary, releases all channels, listener, primary, IDirectSound

name: Snd_GetChannelStatus
notes: GetStatus & 0xFF (0 if no buffer)

name: Snd_ReleaseChannels
signature: int __cdecl (int first, int last, int mode)
notes: mode 0 = first only, 1 = first..last, 2 = all; streams: signal thread, wait, Snd_FreeStreamChannel

name: Snd_FreeStreamChannel
notes: Releases notify/3D/buffer, events, file, critical section

name: Snd_PlayChannel
notes: Restore lost buffer; playing static buffer is stopped+rewound; Play(DSBPLAY_LOOPING if loop; streams always looping, loop flag 0x08000000 decides EOF)

name: Snd_PauseChannel
notes: Stop, keep position; flags paused 0x20000

name: Snd_StopChannel
notes: Stop + SetCurrentPosition(0) (streams re-primed by 0x004A3B90); flags stopped 0x10000

name: Snd_RewindStream
notes: Seek file to data start, refill whole stream buffer, position 0

name: Snd_FillBuffer
signature: int __cdecl (HANDLE file, int ch, int offset, int bytes)
notes: Lock, ReadFile, at EOF loop (seek to data start) or pad silence (0x80 for 8-bit), Unlock. Replaces Snd_StreamRead name

name: Snd_OpenChannel
signature: int __cdecl (int ch, const char* path, int flags, int ms)
notes: RIFF walk (fmt first 0x12 bytes, stop at data); flags 1 = streamed (avgBytes*ms/1000, notify half/end/stop, thread 0x004A4640), 2 = 3D (unused), 0x10/0x20/0x40 extra flags (unused); else static buffer of data size. Replaces Snd_OpenStream name

name: Snd_CreateBuffer
signature: int __cdecl (int ch, WAVEFORMATEX*, int bytes, int dsbcaps)
notes: CreateSoundBuffer into channel; DSERR_* debug strings

name: Snd_StreamThread
notes: Not a Ghidra function. Waits on notify events, refills the idle half via ReadFile; at EOF loops or pads silence and stops after two silent halves

name: Snd_DuplicateChannel
notes: DuplicateSoundBuffer; dst must be empty, src static; copies flags (re-queries 3D buffer if src had one)

name: Snd_OpenFile
notes: sprintf("%s") + CreateFileA(GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ, OPEN_EXISTING)

name: Snd_RegisterFileSlot
notes: Stores handle/size in 2-slot registry 0x007DF3D0 (slot-4) under event 0x007DF3DC; never read

name: Snd_FreeFileSlot
notes: Frees registry slot buffer

name: Snd_InitFileSlots
notes: Creates events 0x007DF3D8/0x007DF3DC, mallocs 2 x 0x18 slots

name: Snd_ShutdownFileSlots
notes: Closes the registry events and slots

name: Snd_StopSlot
notes: 0 -> stop+release ch 15 (BGM), 1 -> stop+release ch 16 (voice), other -> stop every playing channel

name: Snd_InitSlots
notes: 0x009C90A8 = 0 (BGM slot), 0x009C90AC = 1 (voice slot)

name: Snd_StopCommand
notes: 0x80000001 -> 3 x Snd_Command(0x1100A0); 0x80000002 -> stop voice slot; else stop BGM slot

name: Snd_StopAll
notes: Current BGM = 0, stop BGM + voice slots, 7 x Snd_Command(0x1100A0)

name: Snd_EntryBgm
notes: "SS_Event_ENTRYBGM_BG_core": Snd_PlayGameSound(0x80000000) then (id); event op 0x5F and attract demo 0x00426800

name: Snd_CommandS16
notes: -> Snd_Command

name: Snd_GetAudioVal
notes: Debug string stub (DC leftover), leaves output unset

name: Snd_ApplyAudioMode
notes: Snd_Command 0x900A0/0x800A0 (stereo/mono?) - ignored on PC

name: Snd_LoadPack
notes: Debug string only (DC leftover)

name: Snd_FreePack
notes: Debug string only

name: Snd_EntryPackCommon
notes: Debug string only

name: Snd_FreePackExceptCommon
notes: Debug string only

name: Snd_EntryStageSe
notes: Debug string only

name: Snd_SystemInit
notes: Calls Snd_Init, Snd_EntryPackCommon, Snd_Command(0x100A0) among other queue/system init

name: Snd_PlayRepeat
signature: void __cdecl (uint32_t id, short count, short interval)
notes: Plays id, spawns task 0x00435E90 that replays every interval frames count-1 times while 0x009A2D74 == 0 && 0x009A2230 == 0 (event op 0x39)

name: Snd_RepeatTask
notes: Task body of Snd_PlayRepeat

name: Evt_OpPlaySound
notes: Op 0x38 (8 bytes)

name: Evt_OpPlaySoundRepeat
notes: Op 0x39 (16 bytes): Snd_PlayRepeat(id, s16, s16)

name: Evt_OpPlaySoundIf
notes: Op 0x3A (8 bytes): play unless 0x009A2D74

name: Evt_OpEntryBgm
notes: Op 0x5F (20 bytes): Snd_EntryBgm(a, b, id, d)

name: Msg_PlayDialogue
notes: Dialogue line: index table 0x0058B6B8[line][0x009C7000] -> record 0x00589DA4 (voice id +0x10, s16 +6); plays voice and spawns caption task 0x00435AA0

name: Enemy_PlayHitSound
notes: Random BLOOD/ZOMBIE SEs from 0x00577674.. by kind and enemy type (+500)

name: Boss_PlaySound
notes: Table 0x00588EA4 (mode 0x009A1A08 == 2) or 0x00588EC0

name: Player_PlayDamageSound
notes: Table 0x00579FD8[kind]

name: Civ_PlayVoice
notes: Stops SE (0x1100A0) and plays a COM voice chosen by civilian type

name: Menu_SoundTest
notes: Uses SE list 0x00569798 and BGM list 0x005970C4[+1]
